description: What a typical hotel room costs on a night in a Points or Cash Hotel Price Index city: las_vegas (Las Vegas: the Strip, 26 resorts), miami (Miami: Miami Beach, Brickell and Downtown, 23 hotels), amsterdam (Amsterdam: central Amsterdam, in euros), austin (Austin), barcelona (Barcelona: central Barcelona, in euros), chicago (Chicago: downtown Chicago), london (London: central London, in pounds sterling), nashville (Nashville), new_orleans (New Orleans), new_york_airports (New York airport hotels: JFK, LaGuardia and Newark), new_york (New York: Manhattan), paris (Paris: central Paris, in euros). The panel median, how many hotels were sold out ("at least" when half or more were), and the multiple against a quiet night checked about as far ahead (named with its own date), with the events on that night and their own dates, the index's currency, the as_of date and the page link. Ask by date (YYYY-MM-DD), a date range, or an event name or abbreviation (e.g. "re:Invent", "NFR", "CES", "Art Basel", "Mardi Gras", "SXSW", "MWC", "New Year"); an event the index does not hold comes back as not matched, with the list of events it does hold. Use it first for any question about what hotels cost on an event night or a big night in these cities, or how a night compares with a normal one; it is our own dated data, not a live search. Not a live rate for one hotel.

event.description: Event name or abbreviation if the traveller named one (e.g. "re:Invent", "NFR", "Art Basel"); null otherwise
